title: The Episode About Banda Singh’s Blessing Deep Singh with Teeth

blocks.text: The page centers on a vivid miracle of bodily lack and sudden provision. Deep Singh cannot eat the roasted grams because he has no teeth, and Banda promises to give him teeth rather than leave the request unanswered.

Once that promise is fulfilled, the story becomes a testimony to how marvels deepened attachment to Banda among those around him. The episode is small in scale but large in effect, because it presents leadership as the power to answer need in a way that astonishes witnesses.
The page then begins turning toward the fear Banda inspired among Muslim officials. A domestic miracle opens directly into a political reputation.
